mainImage.alt: Massive warehouse fire sends thick black smoke into the sky as Miami-Dade Fire Rescue units battle the five-alam blaze at Global Warehouse Solutions.
mainImage.caption: Thick black smoke billows from the Global Warehouse Solutions facility in northwest Miami-Dade County on March 5, 2026, as more than 200 firefighters battle the five-alam blaze that burned for five days.
